title: 2009 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 3
statement:
A rectangular piece of paper with side lengths 5 by 8 is folded along the dashed lines shown below, so that the folded flaps just touch at the corners as shown by the dotted lines. Find the area of the resulting trapezoid.

[Diagram omitted from this imported transcription; consult the HMMT archive while reviewing the problem.]

solutions.text: Drawing the perpendiculars from the point of intersection of the corners to the bases of the trapezoid, we see that we have similar \(3-4-5\) right triangles, and we can calculate that the length of the smaller base is 3 . Thus the area of the trapezoid is \(\frac{8+3}{2} \cdot 5=55 / 2\).
